description.value:
Graduated from the Child class.

You retain from your childhood:

  • The bonus feat you chose during your Knack (kept as a normal feat — a pure bonus, consuming no ASI or Origin slot).
  • The tool set or language proficiency you gained from Trade Skill.
  • All ability scores, including any increases from Growth at level 4.
  • All items and gold you gathered as a Child.

To continue building your character, drag a class from the compendium onto your sheet — dnd5e's normal advancement flow will apply. If you graduated into the class matching your Knack, your Child XP total will place you at level 2 automatically.
